newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA DUCKS RETURN FROM THE DEAD WITH HANGOVER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA DUCKS RETURN FROM THE DEAD WITH HANGOVER.

text.p: A farmer in southeast Romania was stunned by the return of a flock of ducks he had thought had succumbed after eating wine dregs littered in his yard, state news agency Rompres said on Wednesday.
The farmer, Vasile Sterian, thought residues from his wine casks he was cleaning ahead of the autumn grape harvest had killed the ducks, which fell stiff after feasting on the dregs.
His wife dumped some 20, apparently dead, ducks on a river bank near the village of Cuza Voda. But the birds had only been dead drunk and recovering from stupor they wobbled back home, Rompres said.
